FLOW::this
Description
This iRule command returns the TCL handle for the current flow. On
error an exception is thrown with a message indicating the cause of
failure.
Syntax
FLOW
::
this
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
set
cf
[
FLOW
::
this
]
log
local0.
"Current flow is $cf"
unset
--
cf
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
FLOW_INIT, CLIENT_ACCEPTED, SA_PICKED, LB_SELECTED, CLIENT_DATA,
SERVER_DATA, SERVER_CONNECTED
